newsitem.title: USA: Cyclone to cause flooding in northeast India - WSC.
newsitem.headline: Cyclone to cause flooding in northeast India - WSC.

text.p: Heavy rain from Tropical Cyclone 07B is likely to lead to flash flooding in northeastern India and wind damage is also likely, especially near the coast, independent forecaster Weather Services Corp said on Wednesday.
Coastal flooding will result from a strong coastal storm surge.
The cyclone is moving westward across the Bay of Bengal and is expected to have top winds near 80 mph at the time of landfall near Guntur, in Andhra Pradesh, in about 12-18 hours.
The storm will then move inland and weaken rapidly but will probably produce heavy showers and local flooding into south central India.
